title: 第十三章 秦雅
content_zh:
器市，也有一座清玄阁，修建得宏伟华丽，堪称是器市中的标志性建筑。
憨子从衣兜里面摸出一块巴掌大小的令牌，向看守清玄阁的侍卫亮了亮，便带着张若尘向内院走去。
内院中，一位侍女走进全是白色幔帐的凉亭，躬身一拜，道： “总舵主，墨翰林介绍来了一位买家，他希望你能亲自见一见。”
那一个女子穿着大红色的绣凤长裙，坐在凉亭的中央，发髻高攀，头发中插着三根金色的簪子，长着一双明亮的美眸，绯红的嘴唇，吹弹可破的肌肤。
看上去二十七、八的样子，身上无处不透着一股诱人的风情。
她就是清玄阁的老板娘，秦雅。
秦雅的眼眸微微的上翘，笑道： “墨翰林介绍来的买家，难道是某个宗门的长老？又或者是某个家族的家主？还是算了吧！今天，有些倦了，就不见了！”
侍女摇了摇头，道： “都不是，只是一个看起来只有十六、七岁的少年。”
“嗯？”
秦雅生出几分诧异，道： “平时墨翰林办事挺靠谱，今天怎么做出这种糊涂事？”
侍女道： “墨翰林从来不做糊涂事，他介绍来的人，肯定不是一般人。”
秦雅点了点头，眼眸眯成一道缝，笑道： “似乎真的是一件挺有趣的事！我突然又不倦了，去看看那少年到底是什么来头？呵呵！”
张若尘坐在贵宾室中，捧着一只琉璃雕琢的茶杯，显得十分平静，在耐心的等待。
憨子也大大咧咧的坐在下方的一张椅子上，大口的喝茶，就连茶叶都被喝进嘴里，不停的称赞，好茶。
片刻之后，外面传来脚步声。
随后，秦雅和两个侍女从外面走进来。
憨子立即放下茶杯，从椅子上跳了起来，简直就像是老鼠见到猫一样，恭恭敬敬的向秦雅行礼，低声道： “拜见老板娘。”.
秦雅从憨子的身边走过，向着张若尘看了一眼。只见，那个少年依旧镇定自若的坐在那里，十分平静，有着一种同龄人不该有的成熟和稳重。
与此同时，张若尘也向秦雅看了一眼，打量着对方，心头生出几分惊艳，果然是一个妖艳动人的女子，她若是去诱惑男人，恐怕十个男人中就有九个会栽在她的手中。
幸好张若尘的精神力强大，受到美色的诱惑影响并不大，开门见山的道： “老板娘，相信你也知道，我是来购买一件兵器，带我去你们的兵器库吧！”

秦雅明眸皓齿的笑道： “张少爷，你是打算购买一件什么样的兵器？奴家的心里也得先有一个数，对不？”
“剑！最好是‘真武宝器"级别的剑！”
张若尘闻到一股淡淡的迷人幽香，那是秦雅的体香，格外让人迷醉。
那一股香味十分诱人，让人充满幻想，但是，却又并不庸俗。
真是一个诱人的妖女！
秦雅第一次见到有男人能够在她的面前保持平静，况且对方还只是一个少年。少年的心性不正是最弱的时候？最经不起诱惑的时候？
张若尘的眼神清澈，没有一丝Yin邪。
“难怪墨翰林要我亲自见他一面，果然厉害，一般的少年哪有如此坚定的精神力？”
秦雅点了点头，觉得张若尘更加有趣，笑道： “奴家的兵器库里面，的确有不少‘真武宝器"级别的剑。既然张少爷是清玄阁的贵客，奴家便亲自带张少爷去兵器库。”
站在秦雅身后的小胖子憨子，使劲的向张若尘摇头，那眼神就好像是在说，兄弟，千万别和老板娘单独去兵器库，她会吃得你连骨头都不剩。
张若尘自然看到憨子的眼神，若有所思，道： “好吧！多谢老板娘带路。请！”
秦雅走在张若尘的前面，长发就像黑色的瀑布一样在背上摇曳，每走一步，丰腴的玉臀就会轻轻的颤动一下。
哪怕只是一个背影，也能让人移不开目光。
难怪憨子会那么怕她。
这样的女人，若是温顺起来，肯定让男人喜爱得很。可是，若她不温顺的话，就肯定会让很多男人害怕。
能够克死七位相公，并且在武市中掌握着巨额的财富。这样的女子，又岂会温顺？
张若尘努力控制自己的眼神，尽量不要落到秦雅的身上。
“见过老板娘！”
两排镇守在兵器库大门外侍卫，立即单膝跪下，他们的目光都紧盯着地面，目不斜视，不敢多看秦雅一眼。
他们全部都诚惶诚恐，就像站在他们面前的并不是一位绝色美人，而是一位勾魂使者一样。

只有秦雅和张若尘走进兵器库，其他人全部都留在了外面。
看见张若尘跟着秦雅走进了幽深的大门，憨子摇头叹息了一声，已经能够预料到张若尘的下场。
与老板娘单独进入兵器库的买家，只要是男人，就没有一个能够完整的从兵器库中走出来。
有的人被斩断了手，有的人变成了太监，有的人被挖掉了眼珠子，还有的人甚至连脑袋也没有了！
并不是老板娘故意要伤害他们，而是那些人管不住自己的手，非要去非礼老板娘。
其实，每一次老板娘才是受害人，她不得不奋起反抗，给对方留下一些教训。
正是因为这个原因，那些被老板娘斩断了手，挖掉了眼珠子，根本不敢声张出去。
对他们那种有头有脸的人来说，这件事一旦宣扬出去，就太不光彩了！
清玄阁的兵器库很是巨大，分成一个个隔室，有剑室、刀室、枪室、锤室、斧室……，其中，剑室的规模最大。
在云武郡国，绝大多数武者，更喜欢用剑做为兵器。
武器，分为 “凡器”和 “真武宝器”。
凡器，是普通人使用的兵器。
真武宝器，是武者使用的兵器。也只有武者，才能发挥出真武宝器的真正威力。
根据炼造兵器的材料的品级，真武宝器中的铭纹的数量，可以将真武宝器分为九阶。
一阶真武宝器的品级最低。
九阶真武宝器的品级最高。
张若尘刚刚走进剑室，便感觉到一股奇异的波动，那一股波动是从角落中一柄断剑中散发出来。
那一柄断剑的剑身，足有一掌宽，虽然剑尖已经断了，可是剑身依旧还有四尺长。
剑体，看上去朴实无华，甚至就连剑身都生出一粒粒锈斑。
“沉……渊……”

看到那一柄断剑，张若尘整个人都怔了一下，立即快步走了过去。
秦雅笑道： “张少爷真是好眼力，那是一柄有近千年历史的古剑，沉重无比，锋利异常。炼剑的材料也十分特殊，至今也没有鉴宝师能够鉴定出它是用什么金属煅造而成。”
“若是它没有被损坏，至少也应该是七阶真武宝器，甚至更高品级。”
“可惜了！如此好了一柄宝剑，却被斩断了，就连剑体中的铭纹也全部断裂。这柄剑，除了锋利一点，就没有别的价值了。张少爷若是要买，奴家便以一阶真武宝器的价格买给你。”
“多少钱？”
张若尘将沉重无比的断剑缓缓的提起来，捧在手中，轻轻的拭去剑柄上的一层锈迹，锈迹下面露出 “沉渊”两个古字
沉渊古剑。
秦雅见张若尘似乎十分喜爱那一柄断剑，心中不禁有些后悔，一阶真武宝器就算再贵，也只能卖枚银币，还不如一枚聚气丹的价值。
“一千枚银币。”
她将价格抬高了不少。
“买了！”张若尘十分干脆的道。
别说是一千枚银币，就算是一千万枚银币，张若尘也要将沉渊古剑买下来。
因为，这一柄古剑，就是他八百年前使用的配剑。
当初池瑶公主，现在的池瑶女皇，送给他的剑。
“人亡，剑也亡。既然我又重新活过来，剑也该重生了！沉渊，我会让你洗尽铅华，重现光芒。”张若尘抚摸着沉渊古剑，就像是在抚摸着自己的情人，眼神十分迷离。
这就是剑与人的缘！
秦雅却有些无语，这人到底是不是男人？明明一个活色生香的大美人站在他的面前，而且还是在孤男寡女的兵器库中，但他却死死的抱着一柄断剑。
难道一柄断剑，比她更好看？
要知道，别的那些男人，若是单独和她进入兵器库，肯定已经向她扑了上去。
可是现在，张若尘却看都不看她一眼。

只要是一个美丽的女人，就肯定会很不甘心！
content_en:
Qi City also has a Qingxuan Pavilion, which is magnificent and magnificent and can be called a landmark building in Qi City.
Hanzi took out a palm-sized token from his pocket, showed it to the guard guarding Qingxuan Pavilion, and then led Zhang Ruochen towards the inner courtyard.
In the inner courtyard, a maid walked into the pavilion covered with white curtains, bowed and said, "Chief Captain, Mo Hanlin has introduced a buyer. He hopes you can meet him in person."
The woman was wearing a bright red embroidered phoenix dress, sitting in the center of the pavilion. Her hair was in a high bun with three golden hairpins in her hair. She had a pair of bright eyes, crimson lips, and skin that could be broken by a blow.
He looks about twenty-seven or eighty-years-old, and there is an alluring aura about him.
She is Qin Ya, the proprietress of Qingxuan Pavilion.
Qin Ya's eyes slightly raised and she said with a smile: "Is the buyer introduced by Mo Hanlin an elder of a certain sect? Or the head of a certain family? Let's forget it! Today, I was a little tired and disappeared!"
The maid shook her head and said, "No, he's just a boy who looks to be only sixteen or seventeen years old."
"Huh?"
Qin Yasheng was a little surprised and said: "Normally Mo Hanlin is very reliable in doing things, why did he do such a stupid thing today?"
The maid said: "Mo Hanlin never does stupid things. The people he introduced are definitely not ordinary people."
Qin Ya nodded, narrowed her eyes, and said with a smile: "It seems to be a really interesting thing! Suddenly I am not tired again, go and see what the background of that young man is? Haha!"
Zhang Ruochen was sitting in the VIP room, holding a glass-carved tea cup, looking very calm and waiting patiently.
The fool also sat carelessly on a chair below, drinking tea in big gulps, even the tea leaves were drank into his mouth, and kept praising the tea.
After a while, footsteps were heard outside.
Then, Qin Ya and two maids walked in from outside.
Hanzi immediately put down his tea cup and jumped up from his chair, just like a mouse meeting a cat. He respectfully saluted Qin Ya and whispered: "Greetings to the boss lady."
Qin Ya walked past Hanzi and glanced at Zhang Ruochen. I saw that the young man was still sitting there calmly and calmly, with a kind of maturity and stability that no one of his age should have.
At the same time, Zhang Ruochen also glanced at Qin Ya, sizing her up, and was a little surprised in his heart. She was indeed a charming woman. If she tried to seduce men, I am afraid that nine out of ten men would fall into her hands.
Fortunately, Zhang Ruochen's mental strength was strong and he was not greatly affected by the temptation of beauty. He said straight to the point: "Mrs. Boss, I believe you also know that I am here to buy a weapon. Take me to your arsenal!"
Qin Yaming smiled with bright eyes and said: "Master Zhang, what kind of weapon are you planning to buy? I have to have a number in mind first, right?"
"Sword! It's best to be a sword of the "True Martial Treasure" level! "
Zhang Ruochen smelled a faint and charming fragrance. It was Qin Ya's body fragrance, which was particularly intoxicating.
The fragrance is very tempting and makes people full of fantasy, but it is not vulgar.
What a seductive witch!
It was the first time that Qin Ya saw a man who could remain calm in front of her, and the man was only a teenager. Isn't it the time when a young man's mind is at its weakest? When are you least able to withstand temptation?
Zhang Ruochen's eyes were clear and there was no trace of evil.
"No wonder Mo Hanlin wanted me to meet him in person. He is really amazing. How can an ordinary young man have such a determined spirit? "
Qin Ya nodded, feeling that Zhang Ruochen was even more interesting, and said with a smile: "There are indeed many swords at the level of 'True Martial Treasures' in the Nu family's arsenal. Since Master Zhang is a distinguished guest of Qingxuan Pavilion, the Nu family personally took Master Zhang to the armory. "
Standing beside Qin YaThe fat little fool at the back shook his head vigorously at Zhang Ruochen, his eyes seeming to say, brother, don't go to the armory alone with the boss's wife, she will eat you until you have no bones left.
Zhang Ruochen naturally saw the silly look in his eyes and said thoughtfully, "Okay! Thank you boss lady for leading the way. Please!"
Qin Ya walked in front of Zhang Ruochen, her long hair swaying on her back like a black waterfall, and her plump jade buttocks trembled slightly with every step she took.
Even just a back view can make people unable to take their eyes away.
No wonder fools are so afraid of her.
Such a woman, if she becomes docile, will definitely be loved by men. However, if she is not docile, she will definitely scare many men.
He was able to defeat seven princes and controlled huge wealth in the martial arts market. How could such a woman be docile?
Zhang Ruochen tried hard to control his eyes and try not to fall on Qin Ya.
"I've met the boss lady!"
Two rows of guards guarding the door of the armory immediately knelt down on one knee. Their eyes were fixed on the ground, not squinting and not daring to take another look at Qin Ya.
They were all frightened, as if the person standing in front of them was not a stunning beauty, but a seducer.
Only Qin Ya and Zhang Ruochen walked into the armory, while everyone else stayed outside.
Seeing Zhang Ruochen follow Qin Ya into the deep gate, Hanzi shook his head and sighed, already able to predict Zhang Ruochen's end.
As long as the buyer who enters the armory alone with the proprietress is a man, no one can come out of the armory intact.
Some people had their hands cut off, some people became eunuchs, some people had their eyes gouged out, and some people even lost their heads!
It wasn't that the landlady meant to hurt them, but those people couldn't control their own hands and insisted on molesting the landlady.
In fact, the boss's wife was the victim every time, and she had to fight back and teach the other party some lessons.
It is for this reason that those who had their hands cut off and their eyes gouged out by the landlady did not dare to speak out.
For respectable people like them, once this matter is publicized, it will be too disgraceful!
The armory of Qingxuan Pavilion is very huge, divided into compartments, including sword room, knife room, gun room, hammer room, ax room... Among them, the sword room is the largest.
In Yunwu County, most warriors prefer to use swords as weapons.
Weapons are divided into "mundane weapons" and "real weapons."
Mortal weapons are weapons used by ordinary people.
True weapons are weapons used by warriors. Only warriors can unleash the true power of true weapons.
According to the grade of the materials used to make the weapons and the number of inscriptions in the true weapons, the true weapons can be divided into nine levels.
The first-level true weapon is the lowest grade.
The ninth level true weapon is the highest grade.
As soon as Zhang Ruochen walked into the sword room, he felt a strange wave coming from a broken sword in the corner.
The blade of the broken sword was a palm wide. Although the tip of the sword was broken, the blade was still four feet long.
The sword body looks plain and simple, and even the blade has rust spots.
"Shen…Yuan…"
Seeing the broken sword, Zhang Ruochen was startled and immediately walked over quickly.
Qin Ya smiled and said: "Young Master Zhang has really good eyesight. It is an ancient sword with a history of nearly a thousand years. It is extremely heavy and extremely sharp. The material used to make the sword is also very special. No treasure appraiser has been able to identify what metal it is made of."
"If it is not damaged, it should be at least a seventh-level true weapon, or even higher."
"What a pity! Such a good sword was cut off, and even the inscriptions on the sword body were all broken. This sword has no other value except being sharper. Master ZhangIf you want to buy it, the slave family will buy it for you at the price of a first-level true weapon. "
"How much? "
Zhang Ruochen slowly lifted up the extremely heavy broken sword, held it in his hand, and gently wiped off a layer of rust on the hilt. Under the rust, the two ancient characters "Shen Yuan" were revealed.
Shen Yuan Ancient Sword.
Seeing that Zhang Ruochen seemed to like the broken sword very much, Qin Ya couldn't help but regret in her heart. No matter how expensive the first-level true weapon was, it could only be sold for a silver coin, which was not as valuable as a Qi Gathering Pill.
“A thousand silver coins. "
She raised the price quite a bit.
"Buy it! "Zhang Ruochen said very simply.
Zhang Ruochen still wanted to buy Shen Yuan's ancient sword for ten million silver coins, let alone a thousand silver coins.
Because this ancient sword was the matching sword he used eight hundred years ago.
The sword given to him by Princess Chi Yao and now Queen Chi Yao.
“When a man perishes, so does the sword. Now that I'm alive again, it's time for the sword to be reborn too! Shen Yuan, I will let you wash away all your brilliance and regain your brilliance. "Zhang Ruochen stroked Shen Yuan's ancient sword as if he were stroking his lover, his eyes were very blurry.
This is the fate between sword and man!
Qin Ya was speechless. Is this person a man? There was clearly a lively beauty standing in front of him, and she was still in the armory of a lonely man and a widow, but he was holding a broken sword tightly.
Is a broken sword more beautiful than her?
You know, if those other men entered the armory with her alone, they would definitely have pounced on her.
But now, Zhang Ruochen didn't even look at her.
As long as she is a beautiful woman, she will definitely be very unwilling!
